notes.title: Summer Camp takes part in Games Forged in Germany!
notes.content: [p]We're thrilled to be part of this year's #gamesforgedingermany Steam event! 🎮[/p][p]If you haven't already, grab our early demo and take Summer Camp for a spin with up to 3 friends. Experience the camp magic, compete in mini-games, and see whose story becomes legend![/p][p]Thanks for all the support - happy summer, campers! 🏕️☀️[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539368/c3be1ede42324bf72c0830179cecc67a1a2d480b.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We're in the Women-Led Games Showcase #SummerGameFest Edition!
notes.content:
[h1]Demo out now![/h1]

We're super excited to announce that Summer Camp is part of the Women-Led Games event on Steam from now until the 13th! Come by and be sure to add it to your wishlist. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43765559/sale/Women-LedGamesSummerGameFestEdition2025]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/43765559/sale/Women-LedGamesSummerGameFestEdition2025[/url]
 
We're also launching the Demo for Summer Camp, available now!
